description: This PHP source file defines the Lang class within the Goteo application, handling multilingual language management including translation sources (SQL and YAML), language settings, locale information, and country data.

classes.name: Lang
classes.description: Lang class manages language translations, locales, and country data for the Goteo application, supporting multiple translation sources and dynamic language switching.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Initializes the translator with the provided language if not already initialized.

methods.name: addSqlTranslation
methods.description: Adds SQL data source for translations for specified language.

methods.name: addYamlTranslation
methods.description: Adds YAML files as translation sources for a language and manages translation groups.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Purges cached translation/catalogue files.

methods.name: translator
methods.description: Returns the singleton Translator instance.

methods.name: trans
methods.description: Retrieves a translation string for a given id, with parameters and locale support.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Returns translation groups or a specific group.

methods.name: allGroups
methods.description: Returns all translation groups with their associated files.

methods.name: getLangsAvailable
methods.description: Returns available languages.

methods.name: setLangsAvailable
methods.description: Sets the list of available languages.

methods.name: setDefault
methods.description: Sets the default language.

methods.name: setPublic
methods.description: Marks a language as public or not.

methods.name: isPublic
methods.description: Checks if a language is marked as public.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default or fallback language based on availability and configuration.

methods.name: getDependantLanguages
methods.description: Returns languages that depend on the given fallback language.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the current system language, updating locale and session.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the currently active language, considering session and fallback.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves specific information about a language, such as name, locale, or public status.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether a language exists in the available list.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Determines if a language is currently active.

methods.name: getLangUrl
methods.description: Returns the main URL for language switching.

methods.name: setLangUrl
methods.description: Sets the main URL for language switching.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Builds a URL with language code included based on current configuration.

methods.name: getUrlQuery
methods.description: Builds a URL query string with language parameter.

methods.name: setFromGlobals
methods.description: Determines system language based on GET, subdomain, session, and browser preferences.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Retrieves locale string for a language.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name for a language.

methods.name: getShort
methods.description: Retrieves the short name for a language.

methods.name: getFallback
methods.description: Returns the fallback language for a given language.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Lists all available languages in specified method format.

methods.name: listCountries
methods.description: Provides country list for a specified language.

methods.name: getCountryCode
methods.description: Manually matches country name to country code.

methods.name: getCountryName
methods.description: Retrieves country name from country code.
